description: This file contains utility functions for classifying file paths related to the project, such as identifying code files, test files, API barrels, and infrastructure artifacts based on filename patterns and directory structure.

methods.name: normalizeExtensionSourcePath
methods.description: Replaces all backslashes with forward slashes in a file path to normalize path notation across environments.

methods.name: classifyBundledExtensionSourcePath
methods.description: Classifies a given file path into categories such as code file, test file, API barrel, or infrastructure artifact based on regex pattern matches.
